about: The same guide writer and editor, but each agent may write only 1000 tokens in one reply.
how: A low limit on one reply cuts the text when it is reached, and the run adds a warning.
learns: A low limit keeps the output short, and so cheaper, but the text can end in the middle: the limit has to fit the task.
watch: The warning after each answer that says the answer was cut, and the abrupt end of the text.
